# `armada role`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

Roles are built in: viewer, deployer, or admin in a space (viewer also over
the whole cluster), space-creator, and cluster-admin. Users and services
hold them; only cluster-admin grants and revokes them.

Also: `roles`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada role grant`](#armada-role-grant) | Give a user or service a role |
| [`armada role list`](#armada-role-list) | List the roles, where each may be given, and who holds it |
| [`armada role revoke`](#armada-role-revoke) | Take a role back from a user or service |
| [`armada role show`](#armada-role-show) | Show what a role allows and the API methods it reaches |

## `armada role grant`

Give a role: viewer (in --space, or without it over the whole cluster),
deployer or admin (in --space; not in default), space-creator, or
cluster-admin. It applies to the next call the user or service makes.

```
armada role grant ROLE (--user NAME | --service NAME) [--space SPACE] [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada role grant deployer --user ana --space shop
armada role grant viewer --service ci
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--service string` | the service |
| `--user string` | the user |

## `armada role list`

List the roles, where each may be given, and who holds it: a user or
service, with the space in parentheses for a role given in one.
`armada role show ROLE` says what a role allows.

```
armada role list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Examples:

```bash
armada role list    # the roles and who holds each
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada role revoke`

Take a role back. You cannot take cluster-admin from yourself.

```
armada role revoke ROLE (--user NAME | --service NAME) [--space SPACE] [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada role revoke deployer --user ana --space shop
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--service string` | the service |
| `--user string` | the user |

## `armada role show`

Show what a role allows and the API methods it reaches.

```
armada role show ROLE [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada role show deployer
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
